args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson <2.9.4 is vulnerable to unbounded recursion when parsing
deeply nested arrays (CVE-2026-31337, high severity). Pin the
patched 2.9.4 release.

args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 (fixes CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to address **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity).

## Vulnerability
CVE-2026-31337: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Per the advisory, fastjson <2.9.4 is affected; fixed in 2.9.4 and 3.1.0.

## Change
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4` (minimal patch within the 2.x line; avoids the larger 3.x major upgrade)

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `c8b8ab7878`.
